response.reason: The kernel computes sigmoid via FP32 intermediates using libdevice exp (up to ~2 ulp error) and an FP32-rounded 1+exp, then rounds once to FP16; this double-rounding/inexact-intermediate pipeline cannot guarantee the contract's exact single FP16 round-to-nearest-even of the true real-valued sigmoid for every finite FP16 input (e.g., values extremely close to FP16 rounding boundaries can be misrounded).
